title: Translate email
unavailable: Select a fully loaded email first
sourceAuto: Source language: automatically detected by the model
privacy: Uses Bilibili's free public Index-Translate service. The subject and body will be sent, including sensitive information present in that text. Account login credentials are not read, and attachments or images are not uploaded. Do not use for sensitive mail without permission. Availability and data handling are controlled by the provider.
consent: Allow this service to translate emails I manually select
consentHint: Text is sent only when you request translation. Uncheck and save to revoke permission. Cancellation cannot recall text already received by the provider.
cooldown: Rate limited. Retry manually in about {{seconds}} seconds.
machine: Machine translation; refer to the original
cacheWarning: Translation completed, but the local cache could not be saved.
cacheRebuilt: The previous cache was unavailable. A new translation was saved.
translationTimeout: Translation timed out. Please try again later.
TRANSLATION_INVALID_INPUT: Invalid translation parameters. Select the email and language again.
TRANSLATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Allow the subject and body to be sent to the translation service first.
TRANSLATION_BUSY: Another translation is still running. Try again shortly.
TRANSLATION_RATE_LIMITED: The free translation service is rate limited. Try again later.
TRANSLATION_INVALID_RESPONSE: The translation response was incomplete or invalid and was not used.
TRANSLATION_TRUNCATED: The service truncated its output. It was not treated as a complete translation.
TRANSLATION_STORAGE_FAILED: Unable to read or save translation settings. Please retry.
TRANSLATION_BODY_NOT_READY: The complete message body is not cached yet. Load it first.
TRANSLATION_TOO_LARGE: The subject, body or number of segments exceeds the current translation limit. It was not treated as a complete translation.
TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE: The translation service is unavailable. Try again later in the desktop app.
